title: Smart Data Models - EDINT Vehicle Census - Vehicle
description: A vehicle registered in a local entity's vehicle census/registry, used for purposes such as vehicle tax collection or mobility management (edintveh:Vehicle, reusing SAREF4AUTO's saref4auto:Vehicle).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Vehicle'

dateCreated.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Entity creation timestamp. This will usually be allocated by the storage platform.

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification of the entity. This will usually be allocated by the storage platform.

name.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/name'. Name of this item.

alternateName.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/alternateName'. An alternative name for this item.

description.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/description'. Description of this item.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

seeAlso.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/URL'. list of uri pointing to additional resources about the item.

licensePlateNumber.description: Property. Alphanumeric identifier assigned to the vehicle for registration and identification purposes (edintveh:licensePlateNumber).

registeredOwner.description: Relationship. The person or organisation who owns the vehicle (edintveh:registeredOwner). The source ontology's 'Owner' is a union of Person or Organization; kept as an opaque Relationship since this candidate does not model a generic Person entity (out of scope, and privacy-sensitive) -- may point at this candidate family's existing Organization entity (edint-infraestructura) when the owner is one.

vehicleType.description: Property. Type of vehicle, from the VehicleType controlled vocabulary (edintveh:vehicleType).

propulsionType.description: Property. Propulsion type of the vehicle, from the VehiclePropulsionType controlled vocabulary (edintveh:propulsionType).

environmentalBadge.description: Property. Environmental badge assigned to the vehicle (Spain's DGT distintivo ambiental), from the VehicleEnvironmentalBadge controlled vocabulary (edintveh:environmentalBadge).
